about: The development of technology in this world has resulted in artificial intelligence replacing police and military to uphold world peace.
But the AI defense network gradually became self-aware. It judged that humans were the largest threat to this world and launched a war against them.
We can only fend for ourselves in order to save human civilization.
But this is paid for in human lives.
You will decide the future of humanity.
Prove that you have the strengh to save this world.
Join the Drone Striker battle squad. Represent humanity in the war against the AI.
Preserve our way of life to ensure humanity’s future.
Surpass yourself and become humanity’s hero.
summary: The development of technology in this world has resulted in artificial intelligence replacing police and military to uphold world peace.
